title: The factory's phase=review escape boots the ticks harness (claude when the deploy routes it) with no runners.toml routing
body: 84z closes the reconciler's wave-4 path (roles review/closeout route through [roles.*.substrates.cloud] and refuse without them). The staged entrypoint still hands the factory's separate PR-review phase ($phase == review) to the vendored ticks harness start_harness, which boots whatever harness the deploy's route selection names — including claude — with no runners.toml routing involved. If 'everything OFF claude in the cloud' is meant to cover that review pass too, it needs its own tick (route selection or a ticfac review profile).
